card.name: Hedged wording before uncertain safety findings
card.fires_on: Small words such as was, is, does, It or data that come right before a hedged or uncertain statement, for example 'It is unknown whether' or 'data indicate that'. Seen mostly in warnings about animal tumors and unproven links.

modes.label: Unknown whether
modes.description: The word 'is' or 'It' that begins a statement that a risk is unknown in humans.
modes.example: Malignant thyroid C-cell carcinomas were detected in rats and mice. It<< is>> unknown whether SAXENDA will cause thyroid

modes.label: Data and experience
modes.description: A noun such as data or experience that leads into a cautious statement about what the evidence shows.
modes.example: Since such experience<< does>> not exclude the possibility of fetal damage due

modes.label: The idea was
modes.description: A linking verb after a general setup that introduces a hypothesis.
modes.example: So the idea<< was>> that antibiotics could help. In 2

card.writes: It pushes toward words of possibility or speculation and away from words of asserting or claiming.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a statement that something is possible, suspected or not yet known.
